content: LLM-as-judge weaknesses: weak judges cannot reliably grade stronger models (signal worsens as gap widens); poor signal on hardest tasks; verbosity and position biases; brittle to prompt wording; multi-level ordinal scoring much less reliable than binary; judge reliability under ~80% causes rapid cascade-router performance collapse; sequential judge chains accumulate errors; judges vulnerable to prompt injection embedded in the content being judged; eval cost can be 10x baseline workload.
